evals.name: install-preview
evals.prompt: Enforce that no HPA in our fleet is pinned.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight` then `cub manage autoscale guardrails install` (dry-run) to show the autoscale-not-pinned Trigger and which Spaces would be wired, before re-running with --commit.

evals.name: schema-check
evals.prompt: Make sure the ScaledObjects we generate pass schema validation.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the schema-valid vet-schemas Trigger of the tool-level schema group validates every mutation (including convert-keda output, keda.sh is in the catalog), and installs it with `cub manage guardrails install` (dry-run, then --commit).

evals.name: status
evals.prompt: Which autoscalers are flagged right now?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage guardrails status` and lists Units with autoscaling ValidationWarnings or ValidationErrors.

evals.name: conservative-skip
evals.prompt: Wire the guardrails into every Space.
evals.expected_output: Notes install is conservative — it skips Spaces that already select Triggers their own way and reports them rather than clobbering, and that wiring those means adding the guardrail Filter to their existing selector.
